seeds.title: Timeout note carries the gh argv
seeds.detail: The timeout note holds the full argv, for example the encoded branch path. It holds no secret or home path in this run, and stays under 200 characters.

seeds.title: 10 MB stderr is read into memory
seeds.detail: subprocess.run with capture_output reads all 10 MB before the cap applies. The run took about 200 ms median. The plan accepts this.
